verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator only documents exporting/importing saved passwords via the Autofill 'Export Passwords' feature; there's no documented open-format export of TOTP secrets, MFA accounts, or Verified IDs, and community reports note that its account-setup QR codes are non-standard so other TOTP apps reject them, indicating lock-in for core authenticator data. missing for 10: export of TOTP/2FA account secrets, export of Verified IDs, evidence of open standard format for full account portability, independent confirmation of successful full data exit.
